resources.name: SubmitHub
resources.description: The original music submission platform. Send your tracks directly to bloggers, playlist curators, and influencers. Free submissions (slow response) or premium credits (~$0.79–$0.98 per credit, 1–4 credits per submission) for guaranteed feedback within 48 hours. New: SubmitHub Ads offers beta social ad service with minimum spend of ~$35 for 14 days, and an AI Song Checker (free AI-generated music detector).
resources.cost: Free tier + premium credits ($0.79–$0.98/credit; 1–4 credits per submission)

resources.name: Groover
resources.description: Pitch your music to curators, media outlets, influencers, radio stations, and record labels. Pay-per-pitch model with a guaranteed response within 7 days. Strong European, North American, and Asian curator network. Bulk discounts available (up to 24% off). NEW: Groover+ subscription now available for artists who promote regularly.
resources.cost: €1 per Grooviz; 2 Grooviz (~€2/$2.14) per submission; top curators 4 Grooviz (less than 3% of curators)
highlights: Bulk discount packs available (up to 24% off)

resources.name: MusoSoup
resources.description: Marketplace where music curators actively search for new music. Submit once for £42 (paid only if approved), then choose free coverage offers or pay for additional curator pitches. Curators come to you — no cold pitching required. Campaign duration: 21 days. Note: most curator placements require additional per-curator payments beyond the platform subscription fee — budget accordingly.
resources.cost: £42 per campaign (paid only if approved); average artist spend ~£80 on coverage with free options available

resources.name: One Submit
resources.description: Submit to over 2,200 music curators across Spotify playlists, TikTok influencers, music blogs, YouTube channels, magazines, and online radio stations — all from a single submission form. Credit-based system with flexible packages. TikTok campaigns now available to creators with up to 4.8M followers. Meta Ads combo plan now available.
resources.cost: Credit-based packages starting from ~$10; larger bundles offer better value per submission
highlights: NEW: Meta Ads combo plan available

resources.name: Songfluencer
resources.description: Music-focused influencer marketing agency that pairs your track with vetted TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube creators. They manage the entire campaign — creator selection, briefing, content approval, and reporting. At the 67th Annual Grammy Awards (February 2025), Songfluencer celebrated 46 nominations and 13 wins for partnered artists, including collaborations with Lil Nas X, Justin Bieber, Bruno Mars, and Fleetwood Mac.
resources.cost: Campaign-based pricing (~$200+/post for mid-sized TikTok accounts with <100k followers)

resources.name: SpaceLoud
resources.description: Self-serve marketplace where artists set their own budgets, browse influencer profiles, and manage campaigns directly. Influencers browse artist campaigns and set their own rates. Artists can approve every video before it goes live. Focus on authentic content that introduces music to new audiences. Symphonic Distribution announced partnership in March 2026.
resources.cost: Set your own budget (fully flexible; no published minimum)

resources.name: Kolsquare
resources.description: Influencer marketing platform with a database of KOL (Key Opinion Leader) profiles across all social platforms. Search by niche, audience demographics, engagement rate, and more. UPDATED: Acquired by Team.Blue in October 2024 (one of Europe's largest private tech companies). Now offers 30% startup discount and special NGO rates.
resources.cost: Enterprise/subscription model; Campaign tier $18K/user/year (includes campaign creation, messaging module, KOL tracking, listening engine)

resources.name: Playlist Push
resources.description: One of the most established playlist promotion platforms. Matches your music with independent Spotify playlist curators based on genre. Also offers TikTok influencer campaigns. Transparent feedback from every curator. Artist Protection Fund automatically credits back budget for curators who fail to review within 14 days. 32% average acceptance rate due to AI matching.
resources.cost: Spotify campaigns $285–$1,000+ (average $450); TikTok campaigns minimum $340

resources.name: SubmitLink
resources.description: Connects artists with 5,000+ music professionals including playlist curators, radio DJs, bloggers, and labels. Launched 2019; artists pay per submission with guarantee that curators will listen and respond. Partners with artist.tools (Spotify's top bot detector, trusted by DistroKid and UnitedMasters) to ensure clean, authentic playlists.
resources.cost: From ~$27 per campaign submission

resources.name: Soundplate
resources.description: Music solutions provider offering playlist submission, smart link technology (Soundplate Clicks), pre-save campaigns, bio links, and event tools. UPDATED: Now actively markets Soundplate Clicks as an alternative to the discontinued Songwhip. Free smart link builder with free tier and Pro upgrade available.
resources.cost: Free tier (first two smart links); Pro account for additional smart links

resources.name: Hypeddit
resources.description: Music promotion platform with free and paid tiers. Core feature: download gates (fans follow or pre-save to unlock free download). Paid plans include Free Plan (basic fan gates), Pro Plan $9.99/month, Premium Plan $19.99/month, and Label Plan $49.99/month. Strong in EDM; works across genres. Some analysts caution against building long-term infrastructure on Hypeddit.
resources.cost: Free Plan available; Pro $9.99/mo; Premium $19.99/mo; Label $49.99/mo
highlights: UPDATED: Pricing structure rebranded to Free/Pro/Premium/Label

resources.name: Indie Music Academy
resources.description: Music marketing education and promotion services with a strong focus on playlist placements and long-term music marketing strategy. Offers courses, coaching, and done-for-you promotion campaigns. Indie Music Academy's cost per stream typically runs around $0.04 for campaign placements. Best for artists who want both placements and education.
resources.cost: Courses from $97; promotion campaign placements ~$0.04 per stream

resources.name: Ditto Music Promotions
resources.description: Promotion arm of Ditto Music distribution. Offers 4-week Promo campaigns or Promo Plus package with 2 extra weeks of marketing plus paid social advertising. Campaign pricing not publicly displayed; contact directly for specific pricing.
resources.cost: Campaign packages (contact for pricing)

resources.name: Feature.fm
resources.description: Smart links, pre-save pages, bounce redirects, territory-based routing, and fan messaging platform. Provides full marketing funnel tools for tracking campaign results. Does almost everything — from bio links and bounce redirects to territory-based sorting and fan messaging. Widely considered the top smart link tool for independent artists.
resources.cost: Free Plan (basic); Artist Plan $9.99/mo (annual) or $14.99/mo (monthly); Pro Plan $24.99/mo (annual) or $34.99/mo (monthly); Label/Manager Plan custom pricing

resources.name: Linkfire
resources.description: Industry-standard smart link platform tailored specifically to what artists, labels, and music marketers need. Create beautiful landing pages, track clicks by geography and platform, integrate with ad platforms, and access pixel tracking and retargeting. Only smart link platform that lets you see what fans do in streaming services after they click your link. Positioned as the major-label standard.
resources.cost: Entry plan starts ~$10/mo; no free plan. Pixel tracking and retargeting require higher tiers ($25+/mo)

resources.name: Social Blade
resources.description: Free analytics tool for checking any public social media account's follower growth, engagement trends, and estimated earnings. Essential for vetting influencers before outreach — spot fake followers, view growth trends, and identify declining accounts. Updated pricing tiers available; Premium tier confirmed ~$3.99/mo starting.
resources.cost: Free; Premium tier from ~$3.99/mo (verify directly for updated pricing)

resources.name: HypeAuditor
resources.description: AI-powered influencer analytics and fraud detection platform. Analyzes audience quality, engagement authenticity, and demographics. Database of 68+ million accounts across five major social media platforms. Free Plan with limited features and Enterprise Plan. Previously listed $299/mo Starter is no longer clearly displayed; pricing appears to be quote-based for paid tiers.
resources.cost: Free Plan available; Enterprise Plan (quote-based); verify directly at hypeauditor.com/pricing

resources.name: Chartmetric
resources.description: Music industry analytics platform that tracks playlist placements, social media growth, and audience data across all platforms. See which playlists and influencers are driving streams for artists in your genre. Features 'Playlist Journeys' linking playlist adds to Shazam searches and TikTok usage spikes. Updated pricing: Artist Plan ~$5–$10/mo; Premium access ~$116–$140/mo.
resources.cost: Free tier available; Artist Plan $5–$10/mo; Premium $116–$140/mo

resources.name: SpotOnTrack
resources.description: Transparent pay-per-entity playlist tracking across Spotify, Apple Music, Deezer, Shazam, and global charts. Enables monitoring of playlists and charts simultaneously. Unlike Spotify for Artists, provides access to data on millions of songs, playlists, and charts. UPDATED: Service is paid (not free); uses transparent entity-based pricing model.
resources.cost: Paid service (entity-based pricing); verify directly at spotontrack.com

resources.name: SoundCampaign
resources.description: Described as the largest playlist pitching service, generating over 157.2 million streams for artists. Offers transparent pricing, real curator feedback, and Artist Protection Program ensuring money is safe if curators don't engage. Since 2020, helped over 100,000 artists. Now offers TikTok creator campaigns. Updated pricing confirmed: $69 campaigns reach 30–50 curators with guaranteed responses; average spend ~$80.
resources.cost: Campaigns from ~$69–$80 (average ~$80); transparent tiered pricing

resources.name: TikTok for Artists
resources.description: Official TikTok creator hub with music insights and analytics tools. Helps artists build careers, connect with fans, improve promotional efforts, and inform content creation on TikTok. NEW: Pre-Release tool allows fans to pre-save albums directly to Spotify or Apple Music from TikTok. Free official TikTok tool. Note: TikTok faced US ban scare in January 2025 but remains operational as of May 2025.
resources.cost: Free

resources.name: Playlist Pilot
resources.description: NEW PLATFORM: DIY Spotify playlist research and pitching tool with AI matching, bot detection, and pitch generation. Artists maintain full control and build direct curator relationships. Subscription-based with token usage for AI features. Free tier available for basic research; paid plans unlock full features at significantly lower cost than Playlist Push campaigns.
resources.cost: Free tier available; paid subscription-based plans (verify directly for pricing)
highlights: Much lower cost than managed services

resources.name: Viberate
resources.description: NEW PLATFORM: Music analytics and discovery tool offering real-time playlist placement alerts and rank change notifications across Spotify, TikTok, Airplay, and YouTube. Features artist charts, performance benchmarking, and geographic listener maps. Competitive alternative to Chartmetric at a much lower price point ($19.90/mo vs. Chartmetric Premium $140/mo).
resources.cost: $19.90/mo (significant savings vs. Chartmetric Premium)
